items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: The interviewer introduces Babette ('We call her Bruce for short, but her name is Babette') and the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or recognition.

ctx.x: Wait. Tell me. Tell me that. That's Mike. Come on. We call her Bruce for short, but her name is Babette. What is your name? She's a little girl. She's no... Sir Dice, huh? She no address. She does.
That's all right. That's all right.
